name: Shinjō (Yamagata, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Shinjō city emblem in white: an outlined hexagonal device enclosing stylised characters.
history: Municipal flag of Shinjō, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 May 1949.

features.role: Shinjō city emblem — an outlined hexagonal device enclosing stylised characters
